lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Trick or treat! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Give me candy to eat!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Or I'll make you my Halloween treat!
Huh?

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Since we're doing a Halloween-themed event,

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: I thought I'd get into the spirit.
What event?
Oh, right. I remember.

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: No way! You seriously didn't know?

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: It's almost here, and you had no idea?

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Hehe, just as I expected!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Mica and I've been getting all sorts of things ready ♡
Come to think of it, you changed your profile pic too.

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: It's Halloween, after all!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: I'm gonna give the toy store a festive makeover.

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: You're gonna help me, right? ♡
I am?

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: You're not really going to say no, are you...?

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: If you don't...

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: People will start saying the toy store's no fun because we skipped Halloween...

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Fewer and fewer customers will come...

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: We'll have to open the toy store less and less...

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Then people looking for toys won't be able to get any...

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: More and more kids will end up crying because they don't have any toys...

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: And you'll have to watch it all happen as you slowly...
Okay, okay,
I'll help.
What do you need me to do?

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Hehehehehehe!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: I knew you'd say yes!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: What you'll be helping with is still a secret!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: So for now, just enjoy Halloween, okay? ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: You should start thinking about your Halloween costume too!

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: And if you really can't think of anything, just leave it to me! ♡

lines.speaker: belorta_p
lines.text: Catch ya later!!
